Senses.Explanation: A fixed idiom that marks the beat where restraint fails and the laugh breaks open. Wuzu Fayan cannot hold back before the puppet stage and asks the hidden operator his surname, Zhongfeng Mingben declares that this seat today cannot hold back and points out the high mountains and deep waters as the buddha's field, Zhe'an Jingfan's staff hears the matter, rejoices, cannot hold back, and rises to join palms in witness, Baichi Xingyuan warns that whoever cannot hold back and steps out to trade strokes will rightly eat the staff in his hand, and Shiyu Mingfang dares anyone in the assembly who cannot hold back to come out and try to say it. Lingji Xingguan's Xiangfeng peak cannot hold back, drags the bench, and laughs aloud till the oxen bolt, Yuan'an Liao recounts how Yunmen Wenyan could not hold back and killed the newborn sage with one blow for the dogs to eat, Poshan Haiming admits that today the mountain monk cannot hold back and can only drive a wedge into the hole, Po'an Zuxian cannot hold back and makes a clean sweep for them all, and Qianyan Yuanzhang, watching the two armies locked, cannot hold back and borrows Deng Yinfeng's ringed staff for one shake to make them cease.
